title: Soft SLO bridging and rapid regional fallback hotfix
author: Maya Chen
commits: a1f3c2d: introduce soft-slo bridge controller and config flags
b4e9f10: wire regional-fallback policy into router decision path
c7d2e88: add telemetry counters and tracing for bridge lifecycle
d2f88a1: unit tests for warmup/decay and integration fixture updates
e9b5c3f: k8s manifest tweak for feature gate and rollout strategy
release_notes: Hotfix: introduce a short-lived soft SLO bridge to reduce broad tenant evictions during regional capacity spikes. Adds telemetry and a fast rollback path. Backported to release/2026-02 for immediate mitigation.
description:
Summary: This PR introduces a "soft SLO bridge" hotfix designed to limit blast radius from sudden regional capacity pressure. Instead of immediately invoking hard tenant quarantine or global model fallback, the bridge provides a short grace period where SLOs are relaxed in a controlled, tiered fashion and a rapid regional fallback path is available if the region continues degrading. Motivation: During the Feb 17 incident we observed aggressive hard evictions that led to cascading cross-region traffic spikes. The soft bridge reduces oscillation by: 1) applying a 30s warmup window with incremental SLO relaxations (latency budget first, then quality window) 2) routing >95th percentile offenders to a regional fallback pool with warmed caches and quantized model variants 3) exposing metrics and traces to evaluate bridge lifecycle and rollback triggers.

What changed (high level): added a controller in services/router to manage bridge state and policy flags, hooked the policy into router decision flow, added bridge lifecycle metrics and traces, k8s config for fast feature-gate rollout, and end-to-end tests. The change is guarded behind a feature gate and a release-channel-only rollout patch so we can revert with a single manifest update.

Checklist:
- [x] design doc referenced (ENG-7890)
- [x] unit + integration tests added
- [x] telemetry counters and traces instrumented
- [x] rollout manifest + rollback script included
- [x] security review for routing changes (non-sensitive)

Commits: a1f3c2d..e9b5c3f (see commits list). Files changed: see files_changed list above. Small illustrative snippet (router decision path): "if bridge.Enabled && tenant.InWarmup { route = regionalFallback } else { route = normal }" — implemented with existing policy_registry hooks.

Review conversation:
- Ethan Park (review): "Overall approach looks reasonable. Two requests: expose a histogram for bridge entry latency and add a defensive check to prevent repeated quick toggles (5s debounce)." — Author reply: "Added histogram and a 5s transition debounce in soft_bridge_controller.go; tests added." — Ethan: "LGTM after CI passes."
- Liang Zhou (review): "Concern: routing to quantized models may increase error rate for certain prompt shapes. Please add a flag to opt tenants out of quality-relaxation and ensure we preserve tenant pinning where configured." — Author reply: "Added tenant opt-out in policy_registry and preserved pinning. Updated docs runbook to note opt-out behavior." — Liang: "Approved with comment to follow up on long-term eval metrics (ENG-8021)."
- Nadia Patel (sre): "Can we add an alert on bridge-entry-rate exceeding threshold? Also confirm this doesn't create new hotspot on fallback pool." — Author reply: "Added bridge_entry_rate metric and a circuitbreaker health probe on fallback pool; added a temporary alert rule in docs/runbooks." — Nadia: "Approved for hotfix rollout."

CI summary: Build: pass, Unit tests: pass, Integration suite (targeted): pass, Lint: pass. One flaky E2E test originally failed in local run; fixed race in soft_bridge_controller test harness and re-ran. All checks green on merge.

Rollout & rollback: Deployed as a patch to the release channel and then rolled to main. Rollout script scripts/deploy/feature-gate-rollout.sh toggles ConfigMap and waits for bridge_entry_rate to stabilize. Rollback is a single-run of the same script with revert flag which closes the bridge and drains fallback pools.

Telemetry & monitoring: metrics added (bridge_entry_count, bridge_entry_rate, bridge_duration_histogram, fallback_pool_load). Traces include bridge lifecycle spans. Runbook updated at docs/runbooks/soft-slo-bridge.md with thresholds: if bridge_entry_rate > 5% sustained and fallback_pool_cpu > 80% for 2m -> trigger manual rollback.

Backward compatibility & safety: guarded behind feature gate; tenant opt-out ensures no silent quality degradation for pinned tenants. No DB migrations. Hotfix scoped to routing and metrics, low blast radius and quick revert path.

Merge outcome: Squash-merged to main after approvals. Merged by Maya Chen on 2026-02-20. Post-merge: monitoring showed a reduction in tenant-wide evictions during the following simulated spike window in staging. Further follow-ups: ENG-8021 (long-term eval of quality impact) and SRE playbook refinement.
